decisions.reason: As a large bulk container very close to the firm’s established reusable-packaging know-how, supported by the firm’s own R&D and a growing market, it is likely to be retained despite being newly launched.
This bulk-container valve builds directly on the firm’s existing container expertise and was given a dedicated product page, so absorptive capacity and strategic fit make withdrawal unlikely.

Although the take-back service is less prominently presented, it builds on the firm’s reusable-packaging and service model direction, and its in-house R&D improves its ability to learn and refine the offering rather than drop it quickly.
